subject.title: Add session workspace file preview editing

question: Should OpenClaw accept this constrained inline binary workspace-preview boundary, including the generated Swift encoding type change, once the exact-head checks are green?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and well-proven, but transporting workspace binary bytes and changing a generated native model are maintainer-owned security and compatibility decisions; the protected maintainer label also prevents automated cleanup or landing judgment.

options.title: Accept the constrained preview boundary
options.body: Approve the allowlisted, size-capped image transport after exact-head UI, protocol, Swift/iOS, and security checks pass.

options.title: Keep binaries metadata-only
options.body: Remove inline image content and retain only explicit unsupported-file metadata if maintainers do not want binary workspace bytes crossing this Gateway method.

recommendation.title: Accept the constrained preview boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the allowlisted, size-capped image transport after exact-head UI, protocol, Swift/iOS, and security checks pass.
